api_sections.api_description: Represents the top-level Song object. Used to start/stop playback, create/modify scenes, create/jump to cue points, and set global parameters (tempo, metronome).

api_sections.api_description: Represents an audio, MIDI, return or master track. Can be used to set track audio parameters (volume, panning, send, mute, solo), listen for the playing clip slot, query devices, etc. Can also be used to query clips in arrangement view. To query the properties of multiple tracks, see [Song: Properties of cue points, scenes and tracks](https://github.com/ideoforms/AbletonOSC#song-properties-of-cue-points-scenes-and-tracks).

api_sections.api_description: A Clip Slot represents a container for a clip. It is used to create and delete clips, and query their existence.

api_entries.description: Fire play/pause of the specified clip slot
Create a clip in the slot
Delete the clip in the slot
Query whether the slot has a clip
Query whether the slot has a stop button
Duplicate the clip to an empty target clip slot

api_sections.api_description: Represents an audio or MIDI clip. Can be used to start/stop clips, and query/modify their notes, name, gain, pitch, color, playing state/position, etc.

api_entries.description: Query the notes in a given clip, optionally including a start time/pitch and time/pitch span.
api_entries.response: track_id, clip_id, pitch, start_time, duration, velocity, mute, [pitch, start_time...]

api_entries.description: Add new MIDI notes to a clip. pitch is MIDI note index, start_time and duration are beats in floats, velocity is MIDI velocity index, mute is true/false
api_entries.query_params: track_id, clip_id, pitch, start_time, duration, velocity, mute, ...

api_entries.description: Remove notes from a clip in a range of pitches and times. If no ranges specified, all notes are removed. Note that ordering has changed as of 2023-11.
Query whether clip will record on start
Start listening for clip's playing position. Replies are sent to /live/clip/get/playing_position, with args: track_id, clip_id, playing_position
Stop listening for clip's playing position.
Get clip's Velocity Amount (0.0-1.0 aka 0% to 100%)
Set clip's Velocity Amount (0.0-1.0 aka 0% to 100%)
Set clip's start marker, expressed in floating-point beats
Set clip's end marker, expressed in floating-point beats

api_sections.api_description: Represents a scene, used to trigger a row of clips simultaneously. A scene's name, color, tempo and time signature can all be set and queried.
